title: Employer Benefit Charging: The Amount Protested
content:
Under Employer Benefit Charging, the amount protested is the money a written protest puts in dispute for the claimant, worked out from the records on the day the protest is lodged.

## Definition

The amount protested is built in this order: first the starting amount of the named statement, less the credits taken out of the protest, never below zero, gives the disputed principal; then the disputed principal times the protest documentation share and times the answer share, rounded to the cent, gives the protested principal; then the monthly protest interest times the number of interest months, rounded to the cent, gives the protest interest; and the amount protested is the protested principal plus the protest interest, rounded to the cent.

The starting amount of the named statement is the total of the charges that statement lists for the claimant, each at its posted amount, the named statement being the most recently mailed statement of benefit charges on the position. No credit is taken out of the protest, the protest documentation share is zero (0.00), the answer share is one (1.00), no monthly protest interest arises, and no interest month is counted.

## The quantities, in order

1. **Named statement** — the statement of benefit charges on the position with the latest mailing date. Its quarter is the statement quarter.
2. **Starting amount** — the total of the benefit charges posted in that statement quarter, each taken at its posted amount (credits do not reduce the posted amounts here).
3. **Disputed principal** — the starting amount less the credits taken out of the protest; if that would be below zero, it is zero.
4. **Protested principal** — the disputed principal multiplied by the protest documentation share and by the answer share, rounded to the cent once, after both multiplications.
5. **Protest interest** — the monthly protest interest multiplied by the number of interest months, rounded to the cent once, after the multiplication.
6. **Amount protested** — the protested principal plus the protest interest, rounded to the cent.

## Worked example (hypothetical records)

A position has two statements of benefit charges: one mailed on 14 May for the first quarter and one mailed on 14 August for the second quarter. The named statement is the one mailed on 14 August. Charges of $310.25, $298.40 and $305.60 were posted in the second quarter.

| Quantity | Working | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Starting amount | 310.25 plus 298.40 plus 305.60 | $914.25 |
| Disputed principal | 914.25 less 0.00, not below zero | $914.25 |
| Protested principal | 914.25 multiplied by 0.00 and by 1.00, rounded to the cent | $0.00 |
| Protest interest | no monthly protest interest, no interest month | $0.00 |
| Amount protested | 0.00 plus 0.00, rounded to the cent | $0.00 |
